name: approve-proposed
description: Atomically persist every file marked PROPOSED in the most recent prior assistant turn's `### Artifact changes` block, promoting staged content to real files. Invoked on request only. Use when that block contained files marked PROPOSED and you have accepted the inline content of each. Do not use when the prior turn had no such block, every artifact is APPLIED or SKIP, you have not read the proposed content, or you want to approve only a subset (run the original command in Agent mode).
